Role & responsibilities




Job Title: Lip Sync Engineer (Python | React | AWS)

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Lip Sync Engineer to design, develop, and optimize AI-powered lip synchronization solutions for avatar-based video generation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, React, and AWS, along with hands-on experience in deep learning-based video generation, audio processing, and real-time inference pipelines. You will be responsible for building scalable applications that synchronize avatar lip movements with AI-generated speech while ensuring high performance and low latency.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and optimize AI-driven lip synchronization solutions for avatar-based video generation.
Build and enhance lip sync pipelines using Python and open-source models such as Wav2Lip or similar technologies.
Develop responsive frontend interfaces using React for avatar interaction and video generation workflows.
Integrate text-to-speech (TTS) platforms such as ElevenLabs, Piper, or equivalent with lip sync pipelines.
Develop APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask to support real-time video generation services.
Deploy and manage AI inference workloads on AWS (EC2, GPU instances, S3, Lambda, CloudFront, API Gateway, etc.).
Optimize deep learning models for low-latency, near real-time inference (approximately 13 seconds).
Work with GPU acceleration technologies (CUDA) to improve inference performance.
Build scalable backend services and integrate frontend applications with AI pipelines.
Collaborate with AI engineers, product teams, and clients to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve model accuracy, performance, and scalability.

Mandatory Skills

Strong programming experience in Python.
Hands-on experience with React.js.
Experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront, and GPU-based deployments.
Experience with Python frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and backend service development.
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch.
Hands-on experience with open-source lip sync technologies such as Wav2Lip or equivalent.
Experience integrating TTS platforms such as ElevenLabs or similar.
Knowledge of video processing, audio processing, and multimedia pipelines.
Familiarity with Docker, Git, and Linux environments.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Hugging Face models and pipelines.
Knowledge of LangChain or AI orchestration frameworks.
Experience with CUDA and GPU optimization.
Familiarity with FFmpeg and video processing workflows.
Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
Knowledge of C++ for performance optimization.
Experience building real-time AI inference pipelines.
Exposure to avatar-based AI applications or generative AI products.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.
4+ years of software development experience with strong expertise in Python.
Hands-on experience in AI/ML-based video or audio processing solutions.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced Agile environment.
Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.

Preferred candidate profile
